name: Dr. Mario Martinez
reason: Health rule (borderline, so left out): his own site (biocognitiveculture.com, 'Wellness & Longevity Education') frames all of his work around the causes of health and longevity, as a clinical neuropsychologist working in psychoneuroimmunology: centenarian longevity courses, 'Debunking the Myths of Aging', mind-body health books, and YouTube titles such as how the mind heals and harms the body and a detox week. Almost every item is sold on health or ageing, so a human may want to reconsider; only a contemplative webinar on 12 Nov 2026 (St Teresa's Prayer of Quiet) is clearly spiritual. Contact is by form only (biocognitiveculture.com/contact-us), YouTube @DrMarioMartinez 11.6k subscribers, no base published on his own pages (a third-party profile says Nashville, Tennessee).
